story_candidates.title: Portugal's Center for Responsible AI: the money, partners and goals

ai_path.connection: Direct: a national programme to build AI products on responsible-AI technologies, with a health AI example (Sword Health's telerehabilitation) and a communication one (Unbabel's Halo), as the 2024 interview describes them.
ai_path.places: Portugal; a Porto hospital and its linked health units (the 2024 examples); the European regulation debate named in the programme's goals; INESC-ID and 25 partners.

story_candidates.angle: Three sources on one programme: the State's project sheet (51.49 million euros of Recovery and Resilience project amount, 45.67 million paid as shown, expected end 30 June 2026), the programme's own sheet (led by Sword Health, INESC-ID the beneficiary, 25 partners, a total agenda investment of 77.7 million euros, and goals for exports, jobs and degrees) and a 2024 interview in which a founder describes 18 products in development and two examples. What was set out, what was said two years ago, and what the sources do not say: the status after 30 June 2026 and the results.
story_candidates.note: For journalist-portugal. Ready. Conditions: re-read the three pages yourself; the goals are aims, not results; the 2024 figures and product claims are one founder's account from February 2024 (by role, no name), almost three years old; the two euro figures are different things in different sources (the State's project amount under the Recovery and Resilience Plan; the programme's own total agenda investment): give each with its source and do not say how they relate; the sources give no outcome after the expected end of 30 June 2026: say that it is not known, and do not suggest delay or failure; no partner list exists in the sources, so name only Sword Health (leader), INESC-ID (beneficiary) and Unbabel (a founder's startup, by the interview); put the AI connection in the data note (standing answers 90 and 91), explain technical terms in plain words at first use; short and plain (length follows the story, standing answer 92); categories Portugal and AI.

for_the_fact_checker.what: The State's sheet shows a placeholder-looking 'last update' date; its amounts are as shown on the day read. The programme's sheet is undated (February 2026 upload). The DN page was read in part. No source gives results after 30 June 2026.
